meta.label: Source
meta.value: U.S. Department of Labor Davis-Bacon general wage determinations as published on SAM.gov (sam.gov/wage-determination), current modifications pulled 2026-11-16. Each row links its determination.

meta.label: What a row is
meta.value: The "Laborer: Common or General" classification in the determination that covers the county for that construction type, or Group 1 where a union agreement sets the rate. It is not always the lowest Laborer rate: other Laborer classes in the same determination (pipelayer, mason tender, asphalt, Groups 2–5 and others) can be paid more or less.

meta.label: base / fringe / total
meta.value: Dollars per hour. Total = base + fringe. Fringe is blank where the determination gives it as a formula.

meta.label: rate_effective
meta.value: The date of the survey or union agreement behind the rate (the rate identifier date). Survey rates in much of the South are 5–40 years old; the determination can be republished each year without changing them.

meta.label: wd_published
meta.value: Publication date of the determination modification in force on 2026-11-16.

meta.label: rate_source
meta.value: Union = a collectively bargained rate DOL found prevailing (identifier starts with the union code, e.g. LABO0265); Survey = a weighted-average rate from a DOL wage survey (SU…); Union average = a weighted union average (UAVG).

meta.label: Excluded
meta.value: Specialised determinations for dredging, Savannah River Site, elevated storage tanks, Mississippi River flood control and Louisiana industrial/refinery work are not mapped; they are listed in the determinations table.

meta.label: note
meta.value: Blank except where a determination has no Common or General (or Group 1) Laborer class; then another Laborer class listed is shown and the note says which (one county: Columbiana, Ohio, Building).

meta.label: Limits
meta.value: County assignment for union rates is read from the county names written into each rate. Check the determination before relying on a rate for a bid or a complaint.

meta.label: Check
meta.value: 2026-11-16, full check: (1) all 1,179 determinations used are still the current modification on SAM.gov; (2) every one of the 3,168 county rates was re-read from the determination text by a second, independently written parser and matched on determination, base, fringe, rate identifier and rate date, with county coverage taken from DOL's own county list for each determination (every county and type is covered by exactly one general determination); (3) the one disagreement (Columbiana County, Ohio, Building) and 124 incomplete class labels were corrected from the determination text.
